task: Place the MEDICINE_BOTTLE on MEDICAL_TABLE after removing the obstacle in front of the CAR.
plan_summary: CAR navigates to FRONT_CRATE, picks it up to remove obstacle, then navigates to MEDICINE_BOTTLE, picks it up, navigates to MEDICAL_TABLE, and places the MEDICINE_BOTTLE on MEDICAL_TABLE.
assumptions: FRONT_CRATE is the obstacle in front of CAR that blocks access to MEDICINE_BOTTLE
FRONT_CRATE can be picked by CAR
TEMP_ZONE is a valid placement location for the obstacle (or we can place it anywhere within interaction_distance)
CAR can pick and hold objects
MEDICAL_TABLE is within interaction_distance when CAR navigates to it
rtdl: def task PlaceMedicineAfterRemovingObstacle(;){ state nav_success: bool; state nav_msg: string; state pick_success: bool; state pick_msg: string; state place_success: bool; state place_msg: string; sequence{ do NavTo(robot_name="CAR",x=1.85,y=1.5,tolerance=0.5;success->nav_success,message->nav_msg); check(nav_success == true); do Pick(robot_name="CAR",object_name="FRONT_CRATE";success->pick_success,message->pick_msg); check(pick_success == true); do NavTo(robot_name="CAR",x=-2.0,y=-1.8,tolerance=0.5;success->nav_success,message->nav_msg); check(nav_success == true); do Place(robot_name="CAR",object_name="FRONT_CRATE",location_name="TEMP_ZONE";success->place_success,message->place_msg); check(place_success == true); do NavTo(robot_name="CAR",x=2.55,y=1.5,tolerance=0.5;success->nav_success,message->nav_msg); check(nav_success == true); do Pick(robot_name="CAR",object_name="MEDICINE_BOTTLE";success->pick_success,message->pick_msg); check(pick_success == true); do NavTo(robot_name="CAR",x=-2.3,y=2.0,tolerance=0.5;success->nav_success,message->nav_msg); check(nav_success == true); do Place(robot_name="CAR",object_name="MEDICINE_BOTTLE",location_name="MEDICAL_TABLE";success->place_success,message->place_msg); check(place_success == true); } }
